How to read this report

What “covered” means

Covered is a traceability result. Native OpenFastTrace found the requirement and at least one linked implementation, verification test, and user-manual specification artifact.

  1. impl points to the Python symbol implementing the behavior.
  2. test points to the exact verification test or test class.
  3. uman points to the documentation heading that specifies the behavior.

The inventory validator also checks that every displayed locator has a matching marker in that source symbol or heading. Covered does not mean that tests passed in the latest CI run, or by itself prove that the implementation is correct.

Execution is reported independently: this build supplied results for 0 of 222 requirements. Requirements absent from the optional execution-results document are labeled Not recorded, never assumed to have passed.

req~ring5.figure.series-styling~2

Per-series visual styling

Approved Covered by OFT

Applicable web plots shall configure per-series color, bar pattern, marker symbol and size, and line width by original series identity; typed renderer styles shall also carry borders. Both renderers shall preserve omitted source opacity and apply finite zero-to-one overrides by composing intrinsic and family-local alpha, including source-owned labels and error bars, without changing scientific data or compounding on reapplication. Unsupported or unknown affected native channels shall fail before any panel changes. Legend text uses the canonical legend-label mapping, legend glyphs reflect final appearance, and heatmap colorbars retain intrinsic mappings.

✓ Per-series visual styling, rev. 2, req

req~ring5.figure.series-styling~2

Applicable web plots shall configure per-series color, bar pattern, marker symbol and size, and line width by original series identity; typed renderer styles shall also carry borders. Both renderers shall preserve omitted source opacity and apply finite zero-to-one overrides by composing intrinsic and family-local alpha, including source-owned labels and error bars, without changing scientific data or compounding on reapplication. Unsupported or unknown affected native channels shall fail before any panel changes. Legend text uses the canonical legend-label mapping, legend glyphs reflect final appearance, and heatmap colorbars retain intrinsic mappings.
